pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding to losing positions; pyramiding only permitted in the direction of the primary trend after a minimum +$10.00 unrealized profit cushion is locked on the core trade.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory 14-period ATR volatility normalization filter combined with a 5-minute volume profile delta check to prevent entry during liquidity void wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop activation or scale-out execution as soon as floating profit crosses +$15.00 to prevent gains from evaporating.
